mechanism_narrative: A recent decline in the federal funds rate (1-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signal a severe economic contraction that triggers equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% AND INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's tightening response increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600.0 (thousands of units) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% MoM) indicates a labor market failing to support economic expansion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.
